scope: Allocated-CPU checkpoint writer preserving raw, stored and decompressed hashes.

contract.lift_success: Every observed phase in [0.52,0.60) has egg height >= initial height + 0.05 m and nonzero (>1e-12 N) contacts with both finger links, counted at crossing 0.60.
contract.descent: Height decreases by more than 0.001 m over one dt=0.01 step in the named controller window.
contract.tail: Per-environment recorded fit evaluations, sample counts, integration retries and elastic work. These are parallel work proxies, not individual GPU wall times.
contract.timing: Both device collection kernels and the public position getter are inside each rollout step. Boundary exports are outside repeat timing.

limitations: Clean four-candidate source combination with exact snapshots/patches. Low-shell FP64/Q10/s8/max B2048/623102,600warmup and complete1280-step varied trajectory. Unchanged final budgets. Independent CPU checks the original contact/free-moment wrench after signed P2 scatter, propagating each unchanged original-point moment/force budget to a common reference. It independently assembles mass, centrifugal loading, inertia relief, complete RHS, stiffness/gauge/factor and tensor/von Mises/global peak. Individual dynamic cone/sample fits are separately checked by independent fixture oracles. Includes35-case CPU qualification. Fences/exports perturb latencies and nested fan calls overlap. All environments, metrics, tails and fields are retained. Final-source wider scopes/copied cohorts and plateau are separate requirements. No physical convergence or full RL training claim.
